title.zh: v2.0.22 钢琴卷帘按 Logic 重做：力度泳道、五种工具、框选与成组编辑、量化/连音、音阶高亮、播放头跟随
title.en: v2.0.22 The piano roll is rebuilt against Logic: velocity lane, five tools, marquee and group editing, quantise/legato, scale highlighting and playhead catching

highlights.zh: **力度泳道**（Logic 的标志性部件）：网格下方每个音符一根竖条，条高就是力度；拖动一根改那个音符，拖动的条若属于当前选区则**整段选区一起偏移**。绘制音符的颜色也随之变化（暗石板 → 亮琥珀），所以力度不用读数字也能看出来。
highlights.en: **A velocity lane** — Logic's signature component: one vertical bar per note under the grid, its height being the velocity. Dragging a bar edits that note, and dragging a bar that belongs to the selection offsets **the whole selection**. Note colours follow velocity too (dim slate → bright amber), so the dynamics are visible without reading numbers.

highlights.zh: **五种工具**：铅笔（默认）、指针、橡皮、剪刀、框选——按钮 + 键盘 `1`–`5`。铅笔还会**涂画**：按住拖过空格会连续写音符，整笔**只算一次撤销**。**与 Logic 不同的两处，都是刻意的**：① 默认工具是铅笔而不是指针——这个编辑器的第一动作是往空网格里画（重建前它也只有这一种行为），而 Logic 的钢琴卷帘主要是编辑已有片段；② 剪刀需要**右侧有空位**才能把长音符切成两个（步进网格是单声部的，没有地方放重叠音符），切不了时**弹提示说明原因**，而不是静默无动作。
highlights.en: **Five tools** — pencil (the default), pointer, eraser, scissors, marquee — as buttons and keys `1`–`5`. The pencil also **paints**: holding and dragging across empty cells keeps writing notes, and the whole stroke is **one undo step**. Two deliberate departures from Logic: (1) the default tool is the pencil, not the pointer, because this editor's first act is drawing into an empty grid (and before this rebuild that was its only behaviour), whereas Logic's piano roll mostly…

highlights.zh: **框选与成组编辑**：拖框（指阵/框选工具）选中一批音符，成组拖动（同时改时间与音高）、**⌥ 拖动复制**、Delete 删除、方向键微移、⌘A 全选；每一次手势**只提交一次**（一条撤销），这是我在实现里专门保证的不变量。选中音符会显示白色描边与计数，右下角是可直接输入的音符检视器（音高 / 起点 / 时长 / 力度），改任一项即提交。
highlights.en: **Marquee and group editing**: drag a rectangle (pointer or marquee tool) to select notes, then move the group in time and pitch together, **⌥-drag to copy**, Delete to remove, arrow keys to nudge, ⌘A to select all — each gesture committing **once** (one undo step), an invariant the implementation protects. Selected notes get a white outline and a count, and the footer is a numeric note inspector (pitch / start / length / velocity) that commits on any edit.
